create_scannet_dataset: create a ScanNetDataset instance with data_root, ann_file, and optional pipeline for 3D detection experiments
get_ann_info: get annotation info including 3D ground truth bboxes and labels by index from the dataset
show_results: show 3D bounding box visualization results by comparing predicted and ground truth boxes to an output directory
review_CLASSES: review the 18 ScanNet object classes including cabinet, bed, chair, sofa, table, door, and more
refactor_get_ann_info: refactor get_ann_info to support additional box types beyond DepthInstance3DBoxes for indoor 3D detection
